message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data at any visible point in the data acquisition flow.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from MongoDB and local CSV files with no checksum verification, signed URLs, pinned revisions, or source authentication visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is present in the data preparation pipeline code shown.
No detected model integrity verification: No model loading, hash checking, signature verification, or pinned revision logic is present anywhere in the provided code snippets.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the training data-flow path performs class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no evidence of neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the provided training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) are imported or used in the training pipeline code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation in the visible evaluation code.

No detected input sanitization: While werkzeug's secure_filename is imported and a MAX_CONTENT_PATH is configured, no input shape/range validation, schema checks, or rejection of malformed inference inputs is visible in the provided code paths.

No detected output bounds checks: No code is present in the provided snippets that checks model output values for NaN, out-of-range probabilities, or any other output sanity bounds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline handles tabular ML models (regression, classification, clustering) rather than LLMs, so prompt injection is not applicable, and no such defenses are present.
